title: calappa leiospatha
intro: Calappa leiospatha, commonly known as "Sea Cucumber Tree," is a plant species that belongs to the family Apocynaceae. This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin diseases, due to its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Calappa leiospatha include its ability to reduce inflammation, relieve pain, and exhibit antioxidant activity, which can aid in wound healing and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Calappa leiospatha include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
